title: collect-profile input
description: One profiler collection request. The profiler adapter is chosen by name or by the device description.

command.description: argv the profiler wraps. It must run the kernel, not the correctness suite.

adapter.description: Profiler adapter name; unset means the device description decides.

out_dir.description: Where the raw report is archived.

profile_file.description: Replay an already collected profile instead of running the profiler; used by the regression cases.
